overview: WIM (Written Instructional Materials) document package for JPK/DSD accreditation. Contains professional training materials for BEV automotive (G452-010-3:2023) and Aesthetic Services (S960-002-3:2020). Each subject has KP (Information Sheets), KT (Assignment Sheets), KK (Work Sheets), PM (Lesson Plans), KA (Knowledge Assessment), and PA (Performance Assessment) documents following Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020 format.
goals: Ensure all WIM documents are technically accurate with current industry knowledge
Ensure WIM format compliance with JPK Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020
Ensure complete coverage of all NOSS CoCU Related Knowledge and Work Activities
Ensure assessment quality with varied question types and proper rubrics
Ensure bilingual terminology (EN/BM) consistency across all documents

userStories.title: Enhance BEV C01 KP technical depth — HV safety procedures and PPE specifications
userStories.description: Review and enhance BEV C01 KP-01~03 Information Sheets for technical accuracy. Verify HV safety content matches OSHA 1994, EQA 1974, and manufacturer standards. Ensure PPE specifications (Class 0, CAT-III) are correctly detailed with proper Malaysian regulatory references.
acceptanceCriteria: All KP files in bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/ reference correct Malaysian regulations
PPE specifications match industry standards for BEV Level 3 technicians
Bilingual terms (EN/BM) present for all key technical concepts

userStories.title: Enhance BEV C02 KP — BMS components, HV cable, OBC, battery pack theory
userStories.description: Review and enhance BEV C02 KP-01~06 covering Battery Management System rectification theory. Ensure accurate technical content for HV cable replacement, OBC, pre-charge control, traction battery pack, and DC-DC converter. Add diagrams descriptions, component specifications, and failure mode analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 KP files cover BMS component theory accurately
Each KP includes component specifications and failure modes
Safety warnings for HV work are prominent and correct

userStories.title: Enhance BEV C03-C04 KP — thermal cooling and electric drive train theory
userStories.description: Review and enhance KP files for C03 (Thermal Cooling System) and C04 (Electric Drive Train). Ensure accurate content on liquid cooling systems, HVAC for BEV, inverter units, traction motors, transaxle, and brake control systems.
acceptanceCriteria: C03 KPs cover cooling system types, components, and troubleshooting
C04 KPs cover drive train architecture, inverter/motor theory, and regenerative braking
All content references manufacturer service manual standards

userStories.title: Enhance BEV KT question quality — varied formats with answer schemes
userStories.description: Review all BEV KT (Assignment Sheet) files across C01-C05. Ensure each has minimum 5 questions with varied formats (MCQ with 4 options, T/F with justification, short answer, matching, diagram labeling). Verify answer schemes are complete and accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Each KT has minimum 5 questions
At least 3 different question formats per KT
All answer schemes are complete and technically correct
Questions align with corresponding KP content

userStories.title: Enhance BEV KK practical procedures — step-by-step accuracy and safety checklists
userStories.description: Review all BEV KK (Work Sheet) files. Ensure step-by-step procedures are technically accurate for HV work. Verify PPE requirements, safety precautions, equipment lists, and assessment checklists (process/output/attitude/safety/environment) are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: All KK files have complete equipment/material lists
Safety precautions are prominently placed before procedures
Assessment checklists cover all 5 domains
Procedures follow logical sequence for HV work

userStories.title: Enhance BEV C05 supervisory content — briefing, training, SHE monitoring
userStories.description: Review and enhance C05 KP/KT/KK files covering workshop supervisory functions. Ensure content covers daily briefing procedures, subordinate performance monitoring, TNI/TNA for training coordination, and SHE compliance monitoring appropriate for Level 3.
acceptanceCriteria: C05 KPs cover supervisory theory including leadership, communication, and SHE
KTs test management and supervisory knowledge
KKs provide practical supervisory procedures

userStories.title: Enhance Aesthetic C01-C02 KP — body consultation and thermal therapy theory
userStories.description: Review and enhance Aesthetic C01 (Body Consultation) and C02 (Body Thermal Therapy) KP files. Ensure accurate anatomy/physiology content, BMI calculation methods, body type classification, skin analysis techniques, contraindications, and thermal therapy modalities.
acceptanceCriteria: C01 KPs cover consultation techniques, body typing, and BMI accurately
C02 KPs cover thermal therapy modalities with safety and contraindications
All content includes proper bilingual terms

userStories.title: Enhance Aesthetic C03 KP — manual body massage techniques and anatomy
userStories.description: Review and enhance C03 Manual Body Massage KP files. Ensure accurate coverage of 5 classical massage movements (effleurage, petrissage, tapotement, vibration, friction), body mechanics, massage medium selection, and relevant anatomy/physiology.
acceptanceCriteria: All 5 classical movements described with proper techniques
Anatomy references are accurate for massage therapy
Contraindications list is comprehensive

userStories.title: Enhance Aesthetic C04 KP — electrotherapy modalities (6 types) with safety
userStories.description: Review and enhance C04 Body Electrotherapy KP-01~10. This is the largest CU covering 6 electrotherapy types: faradic/EMS, galvanic, vacuum suction, mechanical/gyratory massage, high frequency, and micro-current. Ensure accurate electrical principles, machine specifications, treatment parameters, and contraindications.
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 electrotherapy modalities have accurate technical descriptions
Electrical safety parameters (duration, intensity) are specified
Contraindications per modality are listed
Machine specifications are current

userStories.title: Enhance Aesthetic KK practical procedures — treatment techniques and hygiene
userStories.description: Review Aesthetic KK files for treatment procedure accuracy. Ensure proper client preparation, treatment sequence, hygiene/sterilization steps, PPE usage, and assessment checklists are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: All KK files have proper client preparation steps
Hygiene and sterilization procedures are detailed
Assessment checklists cover process, output, attitude, safety, environment
